description:
USE WHEN you are about to work with, pay or depend on a REGISTERED agent and want its published identity before committing. Find slugs with onchain_agent_search_agents.
NOT FOR a project in the directory such as a framework or MCP server (use onchain_agent_get_resource instead; aixbt, almanak and coinbase-agentkit have no passport).

RETURNS the full Sato Agent Passport manifest (sato.agent.manifest/v1) for one registered agent by slug: identity (sato_agent_id), agent types, chains, model/framework, the stack of Sato Hub directory resources it runs on, links, payment/x402 endpoint metadata, and verification + liveness status.

Payment metadata is self-configured by the creator, published for interoperability, not as an endorsement. An unknown slug, or an agent that is not listed, is a miss (not an error) carrying the nearest slugs as suggestions, or a pointer to onchain_agent_search_agents; a directory project's slug answers that it has no passport and points to onchain_agent_get_resource. Read-only.

There is deliberately no example slug: the registry is small and its slugs are not guessable. ('my-trading-agent' was this tool's own placeholder and four separate clients sent it as if it were real.)

Example: call onchain_agent_search_agents first, then { slug: <a slug it returned> }

response_format.description: Text format; structuredContent is JSON either way.

slug.description: The registered agent's slug — <slug from onchain_agent_search_agents>. Call onchain_agent_search_agents first; the registry is small and slugs are not guessable.

name: onchain_agent_get_agent_passport
title: Look up one registered agent
